purpose: Durable machine-readable research-governor policy. No secrets, no local paths, no volatile Git/GitHub state. Prose semantics live in docs/agent-system/.

owns: bounded implementation under a coordinator-scoped card
fresh-context adversarial review of exact diffs

terra_sol.scope: genuinely judgment-heavy investigation/review or approved-L3 implementation

risk_classes.L0: observation: read state, inspect CI, inventory, compare, report; any capable model; no writes
risk_classes.L1: mechanical research administration: card/index regeneration, verified state/ledger sync, labels, link repair, post-merge sweep, release metadata
risk_classes.L2: bounded implementation: harness parity, verifiers, deterministic fixes, dependency upgrades, packaging, reproducibility checks; implementer + separate review
risk_classes.L3: methodology/data/model/cross-repo design: splits, holdouts, candidates, real-data pipelines, contracts, promotion architecture; flagship designs, independent methodology review
risk_classes.L4: owner-only: legal/licence terms, public release of private outputs, credentials/billing, data-owner consent, irreversible policy, aesthetic sign-off

activation_preconditions.description: Every non-synthetic lane stays closed until ALL of these are mechanically true; docs/agent-system/DATASET_PROTOCOL.md holds the semantics.
items: tier.json reclassified truthfully (sensitive_data=true, protected roots declared) with context-verify rules updated in the same change
data-policy classes/sinks for the lane are executable, not prose-only
read-deny rules cover the declared raw/private roots for both agent runtimes
secret scanning rejects credential material at every sink the lane can write
dependency vulnerability triage is current (lab issue #5)
the lane's task names exact scope, budgets, retention, and deletion behaviour
the owner has signed off the exact repository scope and supplied any credentials (HUMAN_TODO q-9)

queues.active_wave: ACTIVE/IN_REVIEW cards; lanes, writers, dependencies, and stop conditions recorded in docs/CURRENT_STATE.md

cross_repo.handshake: pinned generated snapshots + provenance checksums only; sync is check-only outside an intentional contract change; merge order explicit; post-merge compatibility check

prompt_system.description: Every executable prompt lives in the prompt library behind a stable ID. The parity manifest is repo-neutral and byte-identical with Chris0Jeky/developer-lens; shared block bodies are pinned by SHA-256 and carried verbatim by every active prompt.
prompt_system.dual_runtime_rule: Every active prompt routes Claude to CLAUDE.md plus Opus 5 low scouts, dll-implementer, dll-reviewer and dll-mechanic, and Codex to AGENTS.md then the shared CLAUDE.md canon plus developer-lens-lab-continuation and Sol/Terra/Luna routing.
prompt_system.human_ref_rule: Active prompt bodies cite human actions as <owner>/<repo>::HUMAN_TODO.md::q-N; a bare q-N is rejected because product q-8 and lab q-8 are different gates.
checks: manifest schema, types, and the lab repository entry resolve
code-pinned common and lab extension prompt IDs equal the manifest and the Markdown, in order
prompt markers are unique and each active prompt has exactly one text fence
each active body carries exactly one copy of each shared block, digest-matched under LF normalization
each active body carries the Claude and Codex runtime clauses
the continuous protocol carries ordered execution and stop marker pairs
any prompt-shaped document outside the library is classified redirect or historical

friction_debt.rule: Material workarounds, tooling hiccups, repeated friction and surprising divergences are logged in the same hop and linked to an issue, card or fully qualified owner action. Promotion to the cheapest enforcing layer is considered at the second independent occurrence; resolution is never inferred.

continuous_execution.note: A protocol, not a service: repeated waves inside one session, never background execution between sessions.

runtime_state.note: gitignored, regenerable, non-authoritative; never stores private paths, allowlists, credentials, or output data
